intro: The preview, with screenshots of every option: https://claude.ai/artifact/AVKRRvthQ6wqgvwBp8DBDJ. Nothing loads from Google until a visitor taps "Show the map", so the page stays fast and sets no Google cookies until then. The map shows central London, where the buyer is, never a street or a pin on us. No drive times and no route. Every option was tested: no answer on the page goes over its height limit.

questions.context: Recommended: (a). Why: it sits right after the sentence about where we deliver in London, and the delivery line under it is on topic. Trade-off: the delivery answer gets about 400px taller (still under its limit).
